sources.title: Documentation Best Practices
sources.author: Google
sources.accessScope: Design-doc description as a proposal for feedback and later decision archive inspected.
sources.rights: Source-specific notices apply; no source text copied.

rules.intent: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code at every level.
rules.rationale: Shared project meaning-preservation requirement; style never authorizes factual change.

rules.intent: State the problem, constraints, goals, and non-goals that determine the design decision.
rules.rationale: Original operational guidance adapted from the identified source scope.
exceptions: Do not invent requirements or constraints to fill headings.

rules.intent: Describe the proposed behavior, major components, interfaces, and dependencies at decision-relevant detail.
rules.rationale: Original operational guidance adapted from the identified source scope.
exceptions: Complete code, exhaustive schemas, and incidental implementation details are not required unless they change the decision.

rules.intent: Compare plausible alternatives against the stated goals and explain consequential trade-offs.
rules.rationale: Original operational guidance adapted from the identified source scope.
exceptions: Do not manufacture inferior alternatives or numerical comparisons without evidence.

rules.intent: Separate proposals, accepted decisions, open questions, and review evidence.
rules.rationale: Original operational guidance adapted from the identified source scope.
exceptions: A requested final decision record may use confirmed outcomes, but missing approval remains missing.
